visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Constructor Assigns the Parameter to Itself
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The book should print Java Basics: 350 pages, but the program prints 0 pages.

solution.explanation: Inside the constructor the name pages refers to the parameter, which hides the field of the same name. pages = pages assigns the parameter to itself and the field keeps its default value 0. this.pages names the field.
